question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Should Howard and Zoe stay together?

nodes.text: What a sad end for Howard! No $ZOE. No vision. No spirit monkey.
Try again and see what happens when Howard steps on the shuttle instead!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But your one true accessory! She waits for you like a penguin in the icy mist!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but I'm not her penguin. Not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So that's it! Our chance to bring $ZOE back is gone! Thanks for wasting my time, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Also, I'm glad I lied to my mom for no reason!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It doesn't have to be a lie. I mean, we can still kick it at my uncle's cabin...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, what else are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Might as well...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Camping?! Fantastic! I already have kindling in my suitcase!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: One, I don't want to know. And two, it's not that kind of camping...
Later, at Hector's cabin...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Welcome to the magic steam room!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't see a thing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's supposed to help you with your visions... Isn't that right, Hector?... Hector?
Howard opens his eyes. His spirit monkey is lounging next to him with a towel around its waist.

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: You're back. What happened with $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's moved on, spirit monkey! It's time for me to move on, too!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: Pathetic. Even after I showed you your fate with Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't care about my supposed future. Just show me something cool!

nodes.speaker: Monkey
nodes.text: I don't take requests.
The monkey gets up and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! You can't leave me! You're `my` spirit animal! Hello?! Hello?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! You can't leave me! You're [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] spirit animal! Hello?! Hello?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Monkey? Anyone?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This might be crazy... And very stupid...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But sometimes crazy and very stupid is what it takes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam, you want $ZOE back as much as I do. Hector, if it were Amanda we were after, you'd be on the plane in a heartbeat. And Astrid...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm still not entirely sure what you're doing here.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: This kind of talk shakes my knees!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But the point is that $ZOE is the love of my life... And I'm not losing her without a fight!
Howard steps onto the shuttle... The others follow. As they're about to settle in, Sam pulls Howard aside.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Have you thought about how we're actually going to get $ZOE back once we find her?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... I've just been so caught up in everything, I haven't had time to think about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we've got a whole plane ride to figure it out together...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks.
In the distance, the shuttle approaches...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I still feel bad about lying to my mom like this. I came to Centerscore High for a clean slate. But that slate is about to get very messy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You too, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Meh. I'm just sad about leaving Amanda behind. And a little worried too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: About what?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: These trips tend to get out of control, man. And, you know, I don't want to accidentally attract someone like...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Like who?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know what I'm saying, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... I understand.
The shuttle arrives.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to go?
Howard sees the sad faces of Sam and Hector. Then he sees Astrid, already boarding the shuttle.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yoohoo! Howard! Once we are in the most romantic city, we will be travel-twinsies, attached at the elbow! Inseparable, like salt and fish liver! Come!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is it... I still have a choice...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I understand. You want me to use my knowledge of baffling European customs to locate your accessory, so that you may make the kissings once again!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's... Right...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I would be as delighted as a manatee at high tide!
Howard whispers into Hector's ear...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's with Astrid? She's agreeing to help me find `$ZOE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What's with Astrid? She's agreeing to help me find [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's a maniac... Who knows what she's thinking?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: A friend to you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And I `am` a girl...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] a girl...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So, if you had the brain damage from sitting in the harsh arctic sun, you would dizzyingly say I was your `girl`friend?!
nodes.text_bbcode: So, if you had the brain damage from sitting in the harsh arctic sun, you would dizzyingly say I was your [color=#3b78e2][i]girl[/i][/color]friend?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! No! We are going to France to get my `actual` girlfriend back!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! No! We are going to France to get my [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] girlfriend back!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It is okay, Howard. We will keep this code between you, me, the angry yellow bee, and the male cheerman.
Astrid winks twice at Howard.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: `Friend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Friend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Speaking of $ZOE, have you heard from her at all?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, nothing. Why?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No reason. Just feels like maybe something's wrong.
Howard calls Hector back...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm buying the tickets now. Sam and I will be at the shuttle stop tomorrow morning. See you then.
As the sun rises, Howard and Sam sit at the airport shuttle stop. Howard checks the time on his phone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I bet Hector's late because Amanda got lost somewhere. That happens a lot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is going to be weird. I can't imagine Hector going anywhere without his `'Manda-Panda'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is going to be weird. I can't imagine Hector going anywhere without his [color=#e23b3b][i]'Manda-Panda'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That reminds me... Hannah was telling me that Hector used to be kind of a player. Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Big time. Before Amanda, he was `the` ladies' man! He once went on a date with half the drama club!
nodes.text_bbcode: Big time. Before Amanda, he was [color=#e23b3b][i]the[/i][/color] ladies' man! He once went on a date with half the drama club!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd he manage that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He told them they were all auditioning for the part of his 'future Friday night date'. It was like a reality TV show.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow! And I thought Hannah was just exaggerating... Talk about pulling a 180! He's like Mr. Boyfriend, now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think he earned that title the moment he joined the cheerleading squad.
Hector comes running up to the shuttle stop, completely out-of-breath!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh! Hey! You guys! Awesome! You made it! Sorry I'm late. Amanda got assigned confetti duty for this party Taylor's throwing, and she started naming each piece.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor's still as manipulative as ever...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, all the cheerleaders have to help. Well, most of them, anyway... Taylor did make one exception...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! Taylor `never` makes exceptions!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Taylor [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] makes exceptions!

nodes.text: Hands clamp over Howard's eyes!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Guess how?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Yahhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yahhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard wiggles free of Astrid's hands!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid! Where did you come from?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Norwegians are the stealthiest Scandinavians!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And I penalize you one sardine for peeking, my salty pet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Please tell me you're not Taylor's exception...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: When I found out the news, I was `also` joyful and attractive!
nodes.text_bbcode: When I found out the news, I was [color=#3b78e2][i]also[/i][/color] joyful and attractive!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: The blond ruler was surprisingly eager to set me free! I felt as lucky as a man who marries a woman with a thick torso!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... That's really lucky... But, I don't have a ticket for you, Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Do not furrow your delicate brows! I always have a ticket to France! Romance must be sudden and frightening!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you'll just excuse us for one second, Astrid...
Howard pulls Hector and Sam aside...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What happened? Astrid is the `last` person I want coming with us!
nodes.text_bbcode: What happened? Astrid is the [color=#e23b3b][i]last[/i][/color] person I want coming with us!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know! Trust me, I know! But, dude, we could probably use someone who can help us navigate France, and her foreign-ocity makes her our best bet!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's got a point.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right... I don't want you to be right, but you are.
Howard turns back to Astrid, who is looking at him deeply.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Is everything okay, my cuttlefish? Do you not want me by your intoxicating side?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh... How do I tell Astrid she can come but without her reading too much into it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, I want you to come with us, but listen really closely... I want you to come only...

nodes.prompt: I want you to come only...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I want you to come only...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We are `not` coming back without her! Yes, you're right. We might get caught, and your mom might be mad, but ultimately she'll understand.
nodes.text_bbcode: We are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] coming back without her! Yes, you're right. We might get caught, and your mom might be mad, but ultimately she'll understand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She'll understand because she'll know how much $ZOE means to us. More importantly, $ZOE will be with us. And that's what this is about, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right. It'll be worth it to have her back... And it's reassuring to know that you're willing to go all the way with this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am! If I have to, I will scale the Eiffel Tower! I will... Eat all the baguettes in France!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm with you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But why would you have to eat baguettes to bring $ZOE back?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know, but you have to admit, it's a fun hypothetical situation.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, then, I'll be right by your side, wolfing down baguettes!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How can you be so sure of that?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... Um...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if we get there and $ZOE doesn't want to come back?! What if she's got another cousin who is sweet like her?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if they knit socks for orphans together?! What if they become best friends?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sam, take it easy...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if we break some obscure French law like 'No crepe-ing on the street?!'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to go to French Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, don't come then!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to go get $ZOE back! I could use your help, but I'll get her by myself if I have to! So do you want a ticket or not?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, I want to help you. I just... I didn't realize you were so determined... It's oddly reassuring.
The group catches up to Astrid as she speedily navigates the streets of Paris...
In no time, they arrive at the house where $ZOE and her parents are staying!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: See! No intestine-map necessary!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This mime is $ZOE's neighbor. He knows that $ZOE is going to a nearby international school to learn French.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Very good! You are practically French already!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: There are two international schools in the area...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Anyway, what are we doing talking like this? We're not drama queens. Let's go get $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Deal.
Howard, Sam, Hector, and Astrid arrive at Le Academie du Renard.
On the front lawn, a guy in a beret is making out with a beautiful girl!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is just like a college!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, let's find $ZOE...
In a classroom...

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: $ZOE attends my class.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Let's be clear, how would you describe $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: French Teacher
nodes.text: Short, sweet... She cried outside the library one day when some ducklings walked by...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's her... Or somebody with a sad memory of foie gras.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wonder if she was thinking of me...
In the library...

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I've seen her in here studying.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Alone?

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Yeah... She studies alone.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: On one of her first days here, I saw her crying, and she was mumbling something about a coward...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Was she saying 'Howard?'

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that was it!

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I've seen her on the soccer field, too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where's that?

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: It looks a lot like a football field. It was an American donation for an American field that no one in France cares about.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, you guys, she's probably there!
Howard bolts out of the library, down the hall, and toward the soccer field!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Run for her, my frizzy-haired steed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's what's important.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Think about it like this... Sure, I had some fun before $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean with Linda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I mean when I was single... That's not the point!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The point is that before $ZOE, I had fun, but I wouldn't trade the fun I might have had for any of my memories with $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not in a heartbeat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's the choice I'm making now. And I think it's the choice you'd be making if it were Amanda we were trying to win back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I wouldn't trade anything if it meant giving up Amanda. I'm glad you put it into that perspective...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Plus, don't tell me you didn't have fun on some of those picnics!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh. That redhead can `kiss!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. That redhead can [color=#e23b3b][i]kiss![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You had your fun single time! You made those memories!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now is the time to step up and be a great boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, memories? We're not thirty, we're in high school! Now is the time to let loose and have some fun!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And from what I know about college, it's just going to be more letting loose and more fun!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So all this fun is just stretched out in front of me, and I spent my Prom answering the help hotline just to afford the ice for Amanda's unicorn.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I want to make `more` memories!
nodes.text_bbcode: I want to make [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] memories!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you love Amanda... Don't you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. I'm just... I'm not sure I love who I've become when I'm with her...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Now, if you will excuse me, please, boys. I need to talk about something with the other girls...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure...
The girls huddle up for a few seconds, then break apart.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: You're kind of cute, Hector Hector Alonzo.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're not so bad yourself.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Hee! Some of the girls think you are cute, too, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Come with me... I will show you $ZOE's door.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yoohoo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, what about our friends?
Colette shoots them a glare.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: I guess they can come too...
Colette opens the door and leads them down the hallway to the last door on the left.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, this is it...
Howard raises his fist to knock on $ZOE's door!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: I'm not sure what your intentions were, but we find both of you to be highly pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: So pathetic that we have decided to take pity on you.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: We still do not trust you enough to bring you inside, but I guess it would not hurt to bring $ZOE out and let her get a look at you.
One of the girls steps through the door to go get $ZOE. Howard motions for Sam and Astrid to come over.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, this is it...
Howard knocks on $ZOE's door. It opens...
The door opens...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're not $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, I am! Who are you?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, your `name` is $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, your [color=#e23b3b][i]name[/i][/color] is $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! It is!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: This is not your $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm afraid this has all been a complete misunderstanding...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, guys...
Outside, Howard, Sam, Hector, and Astrid walk out of the school...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that was a letdown... Our $ZOE must be at the other international school.
Hector lags behind as they walk...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, man! I completely bombed back there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I used to be able to charm my way past any girls `without` a wingman, but did you hear me blabber? Every time I tried to say something smooth to Colette, `I froze!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I used to be able to charm my way past any girls [color=#e23b3b][i]without[/i][/color] a wingman, but did you hear me blabber? Every time I tried to say something smooth to Colette, [color=#e23b3b][i]I froze![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All I could think about were unicorns and carriage rides and picnics on pink blankets with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I used to have something impressive to say about myself `because` I was doing impressive things! I remember before Amanda I once left an afterparty so that I could crash `another afterparty!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I used to have something impressive to say about myself [color=#e23b3b][i]because[/i][/color] I was doing impressive things! I remember before Amanda I once left an afterparty so that I could crash [color=#e23b3b][i]another afterparty![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who have I become?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Who cares about that stuff? Just be grateful for...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Really? You are a disc jockey?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If there's a party, I'm the one setting the rhythm!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: That is `very` cool!
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] cool!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: There are like six of us! We would not fit!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, you're right! That's something a girlfriend might enjoy, not a group!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh! He's right!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And... Look at the city. Hector is very good at identifying buildings.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... We're in one now!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Who cares about this ability?

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: We don't really want to spend the night in...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's understandable. We could always go out to the city and... Hmmm... And...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: That sounds so boring!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! It does!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oops!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: I mean, that's probably what my parents are going to do!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Fire?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah, fire. Um, well, I like to just watch the colors deep within the fire as it burns.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Isn't that dangerous?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Extremely. But that's how I live.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Oh! I see... That sounds so exciting and bold!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A... Thing... On... TV.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Anyway, what are you lovely girls up to this evening?

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: We're not really sure... Why?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I was thinking maybe we could do what I love to do most on Saturday nights...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sitting at home on the couch, watching a... Uh... A...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Watching a...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: You mean on a bicycle like a little boy?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No! Uhhh... In my van!
The girls giggle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoops! Left him hanging on that one...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Really? What material do you sculpt with?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ice. It's a difficult medium to work with... Fleeting, like a moment.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There's nothing more precious than taking a shapeless piece of ice and unearthing the beautiful form within.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Oh my!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector... Um... Uh...
Hector pulls out an old bottle of mint spray. He wipes a layer of dust off of it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Cough cough!` What is that stuff?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough cough![/i][/color] What is that stuff?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Liquid gold.
He sprays some into his mouth and strolls over to the group of girls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector hasn't done this in a long time! He'll probably need a wingman!
Howard follows...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have to remember to make Hector look awesome, even if it means bending the truth like a crazy straw!
They reach the girls...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: We have been talking. If you do not leave now, we will tell Madame Chateau.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Forget about that for a second... I didn't catch your name...

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: I didn't say it. But, very well. It's Colette.
Hector extends his hand. Colette shakes it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hector Hector Alonzo.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: Your hand is so rough!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's because... Um...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because Hector...
Howard starts to walk toward the group of girls... Hector grabs Howard by the shoulders, pulling him back!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't let you do that, man! I can't let you embarrass yourself! See, you have no game...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I don't see another option!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll... I'll go! I'd want you to do the same if the roles were reversed...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How can you say that?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How would you feel if $ZOE started flirting with some other guy just because 'you weren't there?!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awful. I don't even want to think about it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... I'm sorry, man. I didn't mean it. I was just trying to get you to help me find $ZOE. I just miss her that much.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll help you, but only because it doesn't seem like you're capable of doing this on your own.
Howard and Astrid find Sam and Hector standing outside of a door blocked by a big group of older girls!
Sam is talking to the girl who appears to be their leader.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here they come! This is the guy I was telling you about! This is Howard, $ZOE's boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: And I told you already. You are mistaken. $ZOE does not have a boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She does too! If you'd just let us see her, she'll explain everything!

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: We are the first year advisors, and we cannot let in uninvited guests! If you remain here, I will tell Madame Chateau!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Excuse me, I can explain. We've come from America. $ZOE and I aren't together `now,` but we used to be together before she came here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me, I can explain. We've come from America. $ZOE and I aren't together [color=#e23b3b][i]now,[/i][/color] but we used to be together before she came here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I still love her... We all do.

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: You sound sincere, but somebody is lying because $ZOE told us she has `never had a boyfriend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You sound sincere, but somebody is lying because $ZOE told us she has [color=#3b78e2][i]never had a boyfriend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? `Never?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? [color=#e23b3b][i]Never?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The color drains from Howard's face.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you okay, dude?

nodes.speaker: Colette
nodes.text: You are very caring of your friend.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks.
Sam walks Howard to a nearby couch and she, Hector, and Astrid sit down next to him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should have called her...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why would she say she 'never had a boyfriend'?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe she's just trying to move on...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe she said my 'clever lad of a boyfriend'...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Maybe your accessory has got love-eyes after being squeezed by the strapping arms of a Belgian lumberman!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Astrid!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's right. That's the only explanation. It's over. We've made a huge mistake. $ZOE's forgotten about me and found some other guy...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Snap out of it! Remember, we came here on a mission. We have to do whatever it takes!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's right, bro!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You have to seize the moment, like an overripe grapefruit!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're the ones who are lying, Howard, because you and I both know that $ZOE would never lie about your existence.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know anymore... I'm not so sure...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What is this attitude? You are not a squished jellybean! You are a football star! You are a spotlight hog!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: If you want your accessory back, you must be like me! You must pursue like a dog in the blazing nighttime!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm saying this... But you're right, Astrid.
Howard sees the group of girls staring at Hector. They giggle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I think I just figured out how to get past them... Hector, buddy, pal, a word?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Sure, what's up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Those advisor girls over there like you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? No! They don't! Do they?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They do. I know that radar of yours is rusty from lack of use, but deep down, you know it too.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...I've known it since I first saw them looking at me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you also know that you can help me. You can dust off that old player charm and get me to $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you forgetting something? I'm with Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're right... You're right... You're with Amanda...
Howard freezes! Astrid's lips collide with his!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Mmmmfff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mmmmfff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Astrid pulls back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid. We're just friends!
Astrid puts a silencing finger to Howard's lips...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No. You feel it! I feel it! Let's not spoil this happy moment with promises of eternal love!
Astrid winks twice at Howard and walks away toward the school doors.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That did not go how I wanted it to...
Howard freezes! Astrid's lips collide with his!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Mmmmfff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mmmmfff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Astrid pulls back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid. We're just friends!
Astrid puts a silencing finger to Howard's lips...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No. You feel it! I feel it! Let's not spoil this happy moment with promises of eternal love!
Astrid winks twice at Howard and walks away toward the school doors.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That did not go how I wanted it to...
Howard leans away at the last second!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Yah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Why do you resist your desires?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid, I think you're a great person... But I `love` $ZOE. I didn't fly all the way to France just to make out with you. We're `this` close to finding her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Astrid, I think you're a great person... But I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] $ZOE. I didn't fly all the way to France just to make out with you. We're [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] close to finding her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So, then... `Only` a friend.
nodes.text_bbcode: So, then... [color=#3b78e2][i]Only[/i][/color] a friend.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not exactly. `Only` implies that a friend is a horrible alternative. But I'd love to be your friend, Astrid.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not exactly. [color=#e23b3b][i]Only[/i][/color] implies that a friend is a horrible alternative. But I'd love to be your friend, Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: This feeling I feel is both bitter and sweet... Like a cup of coffee with a banana in it... I neither want to drink nor throw it.
They walk into the school...
Howard freezes! Astrid's lips collide with his!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Mmmmfff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mmmmfff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Astrid pulls back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Astrid. We're just friends!
Astrid puts a silencing finger to Howard's lips...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No. You feel it! I feel it! Let's not spoil this happy moment with promises of eternal love!
Astrid winks twice at Howard and walks away toward the school doors.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That did not go how I wanted it to...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE is literally inside a box! And the box is located at the top of the Eiffel Tower!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Uh...
Suddenly, the mime groans in agony!

nodes.speaker: Mime
nodes.text: `Yaaaaaaaaaah!` You have not the capacity for comprehending the arts, American teenager! And your frazzled hair disgusts me!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yaaaaaaaaaah![/i][/color] You have not the capacity for comprehending the arts, American teenager! And your frazzled hair disgusts me!

nodes.text: The mime storms off!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I've never heard a mime speak... And I never want to again. They are mean-spirited.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't suppose you caught any of what he was trying to say in his performance...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I did. Howard, your interpretation was... Unbelievably wrong.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: The small version is that your $ZOE is at one of two nearby international schools...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What fun! I am excited to watch this circus prisoner!
The mime executes a series of moves, each one increasingly more complicated than the last.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE's in a box, but the box is actually a ship inside a humongous bathtub?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, that's not it at all... The box `is` $ZOE. She's containing the mime's secret desire to become an accountant... Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, that's not it at all... The box [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] $ZOE. She's containing the mime's secret desire to become an accountant... Right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's completely absurd.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As far as I can tell, he mimed that $ZOE is locked inside of a safe somewhere inside the Louvre, but the safe is guarded by super intelligent llamas...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure that's not it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think, Astrid?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: He struggles to be heard, and yet no words come out! I like his pain!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I meant about where $ZOE is...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, of this I am in a fog.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Another dead end. We'll never find $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Wait! There is still a heavy cloud of silver lines!
Astrid pulls out her phone and makes a call...
And a few minutes later, Jean-Paul arrives!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Howard and friends!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Jean-Paul! After you got deported by Principal Dyre, I never thought I'd see you again.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: It is true, that guy was a sour grape. But how are you, host brother?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: To tell you the truth, I've been better. We're trying to find $ZOE, and we were wondering if you could interpret this mime for us... Weird as that sounds...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I would be delighted! Miming is easy to understand... You just have to focus on the mime's hands, face, and eyes. Everything else is a distraction.
Jean-Paul says something to the mime in French, and the mime begins to repeat his earlier performance...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just have to remember... `Hands, face, eyes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I just have to remember... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hands, face, eyes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think I've got it!

nodes.prompt: Focus on the mime! Heed Jean-Paul's advice!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: The mime continues walking...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on. I don't think he's going to help...
Howard turns from the mime... Then a crepe slams into his head! Howard spins back around!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm getting really tired of the crepes, mime!
The mime angrily turns out his empty pockets then holds out his hand for payment.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, this is great. You've angered a mime, and now we have to give him the last of our money.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's our only connection to $ZOE...
Hector pays him, and the mime begins performing...
The mime stops and turns...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My friend is just frustrated. I love $ZOE. I flew all the way over here from the U.S. to bring her back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm miserable without her...
The mime places a hand over his heart.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think you've struck a chord, dude.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll watch you. Just... Please help us.
The mime begins performing...
After a series of twists and turns, the group loses track of Astrid and ends up... Back at the airport!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Some guide!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Forget this! Let's just pay for the shuttle!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm with Hector! My feet are aching already!
Howard pays for the shuttle...
...Which arrives at $ZOE's house two hours later! Astrid is waiting there.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ha! You are like fat seals on the land! So sore and awkward!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are there any laws against strangling a Norwegian in France?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think you're protected.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Easy. We're here. We can put this behind us and focus on $ZOE.
follow|astrid

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Home air! How I've missed sucking you in through my flaring nostrils!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, let's hoof it over to $ZOE's parents' house... I don't want to waste any time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Agreed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are the directions coming, Astrid?
Astrid looks the map over...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It's like looking at ox intestines!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great, our guide can't guide us...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Nonsense talk!
Astrid rips the map up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: The map was as old and confusing as a turtle in a sweater!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are we supposed to find $ZOE now?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Simple! I will guide you to your penguin!
Astrid takes off down the street!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know if we can trust her, man. What do you think we should do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's all we've got... Come on, she's going really fast! We've got to catch up! Keep an eye on her!
Howard steps up to the front door to ring the doorbell...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait! Do you remember what you're going to say?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was just going to say what I feel... That it was a mistake to let her go! That I miss her more than I thought was humanly possible!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That every second without her is filled with an aching I can't bear...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No good?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, that's really good! It's just...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I never thought a guy could feel that way about a girl... I don't think Colt would ever have done something like this for me...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Big mistake, man! You shouldn't say anything! All you have to do is stand there. All the pressure is on $ZOE to react to what you've done!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me! What are you basing this on?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, every romantic comedy movie ever. Being with Amanda, I've seen a lot. Most of them `twice.` All he has to do is stand there and look as smoldering as he can while she gets flustered and breathless!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, every romantic comedy movie ever. Being with Amanda, I've seen a lot. Most of them [color=#e23b3b][i]twice.[/i][/color] All he has to do is stand there and look as smoldering as he can while she gets flustered and breathless!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's stupid. Movies aren't reality. Trust me, Howard, she'll want to know what you're feeling.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I think my Howard should remove his shirt, bulge his eyes, and present his beloved an assortment of chocolate naughties!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, not that. I'm just going to go with my heart.
Howard presses the doorbell and waits...
And waits... But no one answers.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's... She's not here... We came all this way, and she's gone...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Do not worry, my Howard, there are other, `blonder` fish in the sea. Many of them have spellbinding accents!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do not worry, my Howard, there are other, [color=#3b78e2][i]blonder[/i][/color] fish in the sea. Many of them have spellbinding accents!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are we going to find her?
Howard starts to walk away from the house...
When a crepe hits him in the back of the head! He whirls around to find...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, mime! Did you just throw a crepe at me?
The mime exposes his empty hands and sleeves.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Very funny. I'm trying to find someone important to me, so unless you can help out, I'm not interested in your miming show.
The mime starts jumping around excitedly, running around in a circle!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, let's just go. These guys are so annoying...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait! I think he's trying to tell us that he knows where $ZOE is!
The mime puts his finger on his nose and nods.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He does know! Where's $ZOE?! Tell us!
The mime crosses his arms and shakes his head. Then, he begins miming his reply.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me! We know you can talk, so just tell us and stop being such a jerk!
The mime starts to march off, angrily!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, she didn't mean that! Please stop...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Here, I will write down the names for you. Unfortunately, I cannot come with you on your journey...

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I'm going out tonight with three dancers who each want me to see their hottest moves. A typical Saturday night in France...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That sounds... Awesome.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You okay, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, man, I'm cool. I was just thinking about a vision... Er, dream I had recently...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, come on, let's try the closest school first! And thanks, Jean-Paul!

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Pfffft... All-girls schools! What fun is school if there are no boys to hunt, break, and tame?!
The group arrives outside Madame Chateau's School for Bourgeoise Mademoiselles.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is just like Monarch Prep! Look at all these girls everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hector? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah... It's just a bunch of cute, foreign, unsupervised girls. No biggie.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Flashes of the past?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Something like that... But I've got Amanda, so...
Sam and Hector enter the boarding house. Howard pulls Astrid back...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, Astrid...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yes, my Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just wanted to say thank you for helping out with the mime and Jean-Paul. You really came through back there.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, Howard! I have longed to hear those words!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you actually hearing me?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Of course! My attention is on your eye-troughs. On the slight upward angle of your nostrils. On the irresistible grimace of your mouth!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... I know that you pretty much always have romantic thoughts about me...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh so romantic! I've imagined kissings with you that would make a walrus blush! I'm imagining kissings with you now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... But, this is not a romantic moment.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: It is time, my pet! I cannot resist! We are single! It is Paris! We are both thinking the same forbidden thoughts! We will make the kissings `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It is time, my pet! I cannot resist! We are single! It is Paris! We are both thinking the same forbidden thoughts! We will make the kissings [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Astrid leans in toward Howard, her lips puckered!
The shuttle arrives.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to go?
Howard sees the sad faces of Sam and Hector. Then he sees Astrid, already boarding the shuttle.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yoohoo! Howard! Once we are in the most romantic city, we will be travel-twinsies, attached at the elbow! Inseparable, like salt and fish liver! Come!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is it... I still have a choice...

Let's check in on what's going on at Centerscore High!
Denni is scrubbing off some locker graffiti...
Stupid vandals! Can't even spell `'was'`.
When Colt walks by...
Tiny Hipster?!
Colt! I didn't expect to see you here.
Yeah, I, uh, had to grab a few... Uh, personal things.
He pats his backpack, and it makes a clinking sound.
What? Are you trying to be ironic? Skip class when school's in session, attend during the summer break?
Nah. I just wanted to see you doing manual labor. I didn't think you Princesses stepped down from your high horses for this kind of thing.
Har har. When you're the leader of W.H.A.L.E, summer is the time for cleaning up after all the morons who think it's fun to ruin school property.
Those jerks.
I assume by your tone that I'm also scrubbing off some of your work, too.
You caught me. That's mine right there. 'Ben wuz here.' Heh.
It's not that funny.
Well, not `now.` But it will be when that Ben nerd tries to defend himself to Shapiro by explaining how great a speller he is.
...Okay, not bad.
I haven't seen you around much lately... Are you going to attend any of $Scott's barbecues?
Uh... I'm not sure. Have you been going to those?
I've been trying to. They're really fun! You should come!
I don't know... Group activities... Water guns... It's too `family day` for me.
Oh... Well, then I guess I'll see you back when school starts up again?
Yup. I'll see you some time.
Colt walks away from Denni...
'See me some time?'
I wonder what he meant by that...

I was understanding when her parents took her away! We agreed to make the most of our Fourth of July!

And what happened? I got shellacked by a crepe, Hector lost his mojo, and now $ZOE's probably going out with some irresistible Italian guy!
Well, fine, I get it! The universe doesn't want me to find $ZOE because we're not meant to be together!
No, Howard, don't...
Howard notices Astrid looking deeply into his eyes...
And I haven't been fair to you at all, Astrid. You've been here from the beginning...
Ever since you came to Centerscore, you've been there for me. I'm confident that if you ever got taken away, it wouldn't be nearly this hard for me to find you.
I would warble endlessly for you.
Howard takes a step toward Astrid...
What are you doing, dude?
Come to me, my wandering forest fox!
Maybe who I'm supposed to be with has been right here in front of me, this whole time...
Howard takes another step toward Astrid.
I am your reflection. Always here for you. Even on your ugly days.
Howard reaches Astrid and puts his hands on her waist...
I know it. It's clear to me now, that you only have so many choices in life...
Go on, my salt lick.
Howard begins to lean in toward Astrid...
Kiss me now, or I will scream like a whale giving birth!
And eventually, you run out of choices altogether...
Make your choice!
Kiss Astrid!
What should you do?
Howard kisses Astrid!
`Mffffffffff!`
After far too long, Astrid suctions herself off of Howard's mouth.
We are together now! We are the penguin soulmates!
Yes... We are...
Gross! Howard and Astrid?! Without a doubt, this is `not` why Howard came to France! And this is not the ending you wanted!
Play again! Help Howard find $ZOE and avoid such a miserable fate!
Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!
In the distance, he sees $ZOE sitting on a bench next to another guy!
No!
Howard keeps running toward them. He can hear the echo of their voices across the field...
Destiny led you to me... And me to you.
You and Howard were `meant` to break up. Just as I was `meant` to break up with Adrianna today!
No! No! No!
Howard runs as fast as he can!
You broke up with Adrianna?!
This is the way it was always meant to be, $ZOE.
Now there's no one to keep us apart. We're just two people. Nothing can separate us now.
Before Howard can react, Matteo leans in and kisses her!
She does not resist.
$ZOE! NOOOOOOO!
Whoa! Another guy kissed $ZOE! How could that happen? And who is Matteo?! Find out in the next episode, `French Kiss, Paris Part 2!`
For now, though, congratulations! You helped Howard find $ZOE by reading maps, dealing with mimes, and acting as a wingman! You played a great game!
Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!
Howard runs to the soccer field!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points!
Your grade for this episode is... F!
Your grade for this episode is... D!
Your grade for this episode is... C!
Your grade for this episode is... B!
You got the `perfect` score!
Your grade for this episode is... A++!
Your grade for this episode is... A!

nodes.text: Unable to cope with the idea of life without $ZOE, Howard has decided to go to France to get her back! And now...
Howard is on the phone with Hector...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm going to buy plane tickets now for the earliest possible departure tomorrow morning...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you're going to buy `five` tickets?
nodes.text_bbcode: And you're going to buy [color=#e23b3b][i]five[/i][/color] tickets?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, for me, you, Sam, Amanda, and of course, one for $ZOE for the return trip!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda can't make it, man. She's pretty bummed. Taylor's planning some kind of party, and all the cheerleaders have to help.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, man, that sucks.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Less money for you to spend... By the way, I appreciate your offer to pay for all the tickets, but that's a lot of money! Are you sure, man?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm sure. Normally, I wouldn't even be able to afford my ticket, but Kay and Kel offered me a loan.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The treehouse business is lucrative.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Plus, they offered me an interest rate I could not refuse...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's unusually generous of them... Has the new baby changed their outlook that much?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think it's more that they just really want me to bring $ZOE back so we can play pirates again in the backyard.
Suddenly, Sam bursts into Howard's room!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Yah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We have to talk!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Hector, I'll call you back.
Howard hangs up the phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't do this! I want $ZOE back too, but I can't do something this irresponsible! I was stressing out when I snuck out to the racetrack with the swim team! That was within the city... This is another country!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't go to `France!` I can't even speak French! I can't lie to my mom and tell her I'm staying at Hector's uncle's cabin! I can't reset all this progress I've made toward being good!
